short_caption: Glass greenhouse interior with grass floor, leafy plants and three block figures
literal_description: Interior of a greenhouse with a grey metal frame and large glass panes forming the walls and a pitched roof. The floor is green grass with bare brown dirt patches and a few small stones, crossed by the shadow grid of the window frame. Dense broad-leaf green plants and ferns line the left and right sides and the base of the back wall, with small glowing yellow-green orbs among the leaves and floating in the air. Three cube-shaped block figures with dark rectangular eyes sit on short block pedestals in a row at mid distance: terracotta brown on the left, green in the centre, orange on the right. Through the glass are blue sky, white clouds, green trees and distant hills. The camera is at standing eye height looking straight towards the back wall.
environment: Indoor glass greenhouse with a grass and dirt floor, overgrown with leafy plants and hanging vines, with trees and hills visible outside in daylight.
visual_style: stylised flat-shaded cartoon game art, soft painterly shapes, saturated greens and blues
lighting: Bright soft daylight entering through the glass roof and back wall, casting a grid of soft frame shadows on the floor; cool blue-green ambient tone with small yellow-green point glows from the plants; moderate contrast.
atmosphere: floating glowing yellow-green orbs with soft halos, light haze in the distance outside
ambient_sound: soft rustling leaves, gentle breeze through glass panes and metal frame, faint insect hum, distant birdsong
backdrop: glass greenhouse wall with metal frame, trees and hills beyo
